I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest. I don't have a scheduling tool in this conversation, so nothing will arrive automatically tomorrow morning, and I won't say otherwise.

You are a member of #coastal-team, so I can do the digest on demand. Send "coastal digest" any morning and I'll DM you what's new in the channel since your last one. If you want it fully automatic, someone with scheduling access will need to set up the job.
